add_definitions(-DDIRECTINPUT_VERSION=0x0700)
spec2def(dinput.dll dinput.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_library(dinput_data_formats data_formats.c)
add_dependencies(dinput_data_formats psdk)
set_wine_module_FIXME(dinput_data_formats) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# dinput.dll is all Rust (dinput-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dinput-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# config.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/config.rs)
# device.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/device.rs)
# dinput_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/dinput_main.rs)
# effect_linuxinput.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/effect_linuxinput/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# joystick.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/joystick.rs)
# joystick_linux.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/joystick_linux/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# joystick_linuxinput.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/joystick_linuxinput/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# joystick_osx.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/joystick_osx/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# keyboard.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/keyboard.rs)
# mouse.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/mouse.rs)
# data_formats.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dinput-rust/src/dinput/data_formats/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(dinput_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(dinput_shims PRIVATE dxguid uuid wine libcomctl32 libole32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(dinput_shims)
add_cargo_module(dinput dinput-cargo dinput.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE dinput-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dinput_shims psdk uuid_sources)
